props.name: value
props.description: The text in the field. Free text is allowed — this is not a Select.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear button once there is text. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Omit to hide the list instead.

props.name: filter
props.description:
Custom matcher. Defaults to a case- and accent-insensitive substring test
over `label`. Pass `() => true` when the options are filtered server-side.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner in the field — for options still being fetched.

props.name: maxSuggestions
props.description: Caps the visible suggestions. Defaults to 8.

props.name: minChars
props.description: Characters required before suggestions appear. Defaults to 1.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape: full circle, rounded corners, or square.

props.name: max
props.description: Cap shown as "max+" when count exceeds it.

props.name: showZero
props.description: Render the badge even when count is 0 (hidden by default).

props.name: actions
props.description: Up to two actions, rendered right-aligned below the message.

props.name: dismissable
props.description: Show a close (X) button; requires onDismiss.

props.name: bg
props.description: Background — an M3 color role name or a raw color.

props.name: m
props.description: Margin on every edge.

props.name: p
props.description: Padding on every edge.

props.name: px
props.description: Horizontal padding.

props.name: py
props.description: Vertical padding.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius — a shape token name or a raw radius.

props.name: row
props.description: Lays children out horizontally instead of vertically.

props.name: maxItems
props.description: Collapse middle items behind an ellipsis when exceeding this count.

props.name: busy
props.description:
Blocks presses and announces the button as busy, but — unlike `loading` —
keeps the label, the icon and the full-strength colours on screen.

props.name: fullWidth
props.description: Stretch to fill the parent width.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Icon side relative to the label.

props.name: labelStyle
props.description: Applied to the label text, after the theme's type style.

props.name: tone
props.description:
Colour role. `error` is the destructive treatment (delete, discard);
`success` is confirmation feedback, from a fixed green kept off the seed.

props.name: underlay
props.description:
Drawn behind the label across the whole surface, clipped to its shape:
a progress fill, a state animation. It receives no touches.

props.name: align
props.description: Where the buttons sit on the row. M3 puts card actions on the right.

props.name: alt
props.description: Alternative text — an unnamed image is invisible to a screen reader.

props.name: ratio
props.description: Width divided by height. M3 card covers default to 16:9.

props.name: left
props.description: Leading slot — an `Avatar`, an `Icon`, a `StatusBadge`.

props.name: right
props.description: Trailing slot — an `IconButton`, a `Menu` anchor, a `Chip`.

props.name: indeterminate
props.description: Mixed state (e.g. "select all" with partial selection); overrides the checkmark.

props.name: accessibilityRole
props.description:
Overrides the role of a pressable chip (`"button"`). A chip that toggles
inside a group is a `"radio"` or a `"checkbox"`, and then reports
`selected` as checked.

props.name: size
props.description: "small" renders a compact 24px chip.

props.name: emptyMessage
props.description: Shown centered when data is empty and not loading.

props.name: value
props.description: `null` renders `placeholder` instead of a formatted value.

props.name: clearable
props.description: Adds a clear affordance to the field. Needs `onClear` to do anything.

props.name: defaultInputType
props.description: Which surface the dialog opens on. Default `"picker"`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the picker already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: endYear
props.description: Last year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years on.

props.name: error
props.description: Error text below the field; also recolors the field.

props.name: firstDayOfWeek
props.description: 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday. Defaults to the locale's own week start.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: inputEnabled
props.description: Lets the user type the value straight into the field. Default `true`.

props.name: isDateDisabled
props.description: Excludes days `validRange` cannot express (weekends, a computed holiday set).

props.name: labels
props.description: Chrome strings of the picker surface (nav buttons, "Today", "Clear", …).

props.name: locale
props.description: Overrides the formatting/labelling locale. Defaults to the device locale.

props.name: minuteInterval
props.description: Minute granularity of the clock. Defaults to 1.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the field has no value.

props.name: relativeLabels
props.description:
Overrides the relative day labels, e.g. from i18n:
`relativeLabels={{ today: t("TODAY"), yesterday: t("YESTERDAY") }}`.
Defaults to the device locale via Intl.RelativeTimeFormat.

props.name: required
props.description: Appends an asterisk to the label.

props.name: scrollMode
props.description: Month navigation inside the dialog. Default `"endless"`.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.name: use24HourClock
props.description: Forces the 24-hour clock face. Left unset, the locale decides.

props.name: validRange
props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: startYear
props.description: First year offered by the year grid. Defaults to 100 years back.

props.description: The selectable window plus individual excluded days.

props.name: children
props.description:
Centred label, splitting the rule in two. Horizontal only — a vertical
divider is a bare rule.

props.name: contentSpacing
props.description: Gap between the label and each half of the rule. No label, no gap.

props.name: inset
props.description: Margin at both ends of the line, along its own axis.

props.name: thickness
props.description: Line thickness, in pixels.

props.name: columns
props.description: Fixed column count. Ignored when `minChildWidth` is set.

props.name: minChildWidth
props.description:
Responsive alternative to `columns`: fits as many columns of at least this
width as the container allows.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between cells — a spacing token name or a raw value.

props.name: children
props.description:
A glyph name (a MaterialCommunityIcons name), as MUI's Icon takes its
ligature: `<Icon>plus</Icon>`. The theme picks the drawing: Material, or
Eva (`createTheme({ icons: "eva" })`). A glyph Eva has no drawing for is
drawn in Material, with a warning in development.

props.name: color
props.description: A palette name, a palette path, a Material 3 role or any raw colour.

props.name: flipForRTL
props.description: Mirror the glyph when the layout direction is RTL (arrows, chevrons).

props.name: fontSize
props.description: MUI's sizes: small 20, medium 24, large 35 — or any number.

props.name: source
props.description: A bitmap, a render function or a ready-made element, when the icon is not a glyph.

props.name: style
props.description: A `color` in the style tints the glyph, as it does on a vector-icons glyph.

props.name: accessibilityLabel
props.description: Required: an icon alone carries no accessible name.

props.name: mode
props.description: M3 icon-button container styles. Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: selected
props.description: Renders the M3 "selected" container of a toggle icon button.

props.name: helperText
props.description: Supporting text below the field; hidden while an error is shown.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the label with an asterisk.

props.name: allowedSchemes
props.description:
URL schemes `href` may use. A link whose `href` came from data (a user's
website, a CMS field) must not be able to open `javascript:`, `intent:` or
another app's deep link. Add your own app's scheme here to deep-link.
Defaults to `["http", "https", "mailto", "tel"]`.

props.name: href
props.description:
Opened with `Linking.openURL`. Ignored when `onPress` is given, and when
its scheme is not in `allowedSchemes` — then the link does nothing.

props.name: showExternalIcon
props.description: Appends an external-link icon. Defaults to `true` when `href` is remote.

props.name: underline
props.description: Underline behaviour. Defaults to `"hover"`.

props.name: variant
props.description: MUI typography variant for the label. Defaults to `"body2"`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Leading slot — an Avatar, an icon, a Checkbox.

props.name: secondary
props.description: Second line below `children`.

props.name: trailing
props.description: Trailing slot — a value, a Toggle, a chevron.

props.name: divider
props.description: Rule below the section, for a settings screen of stacked groups.

props.name: title
props.description: Group label rendered above the rows as a heading.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Close the menu automatically after an item is pressed. Default true.

props.name: destructive
props.description: Renders the confirm action in the error tone (delete, discard).

props.name: dismissable
props.description:
Whether the scrim and ESC cancel the dialog. Leave it off for a decision
the user must answer explicitly. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title.

props.name: visible
props.description: Whether the dialog is on screen.

props.name: actions
props.description:
Trailing action row. Replaces the single `closeText` button. In a
full-screen dialog it moves into the header, after the title.

props.name: dismissable
props.description:
Whether tapping the scrim (and pressing ESC on web) dismisses the dialog.
Turn it off for a decision the user must not be able to skip.
Defaults to `true`.

props.name: fullScreen
props.description:
The M3 full-screen dialog, for a form on a compact window: it fills the
window, with a close button, the title and `actions` in a header row and
a scrolling body. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Hero glyph above the title (M3 dialog icon). Centres the header.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Called on Android back / ESC without rendering the close button. Falls back to onClose.

props.name: scrollable
props.description: Scrolls the body when the content is taller than the dialog.

props.name: testID
props.description: Root testID. The scrim gets `${testID}-scrim`.

props.name: showLabels
props.description: "always" shows every label, "selected" only the active one.

props.name: children
props.description: `DrawerSection`s and/or `DrawerItem`s.

props.name: footer
props.description: Pinned below the scrolling items.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Modal only: called on scrim press, Android back and Escape (web).

props.name: title
props.description: Headline at the top of the drawer.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"standard"` is an inline panel to place beside the content (expanded
windows and up). `"modal"` slides over the content with a scrim.
Defaults to `"standard"`.

props.name: visible
props.description: Modal only: whether the drawer is open.

props.name: width
props.description: Defaults to 360 (M3), capped at the window width when modal.

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called after the clear button empties the field.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the option list already open. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: animate
props.description: false renders a static placeholder (no pulse).

props.name: duration
props.description: Pulse animation duration for a full cycle (ms).

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Mount with the action stack already expanded. Uncontrolled after that.

props.name: direction
props.description: Stacking axis. Defaults to `"vertical"`.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Reverses the visual order without touching the children array.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Gap between children — a spacing token name or a raw value.

props.name: containerStyle
props.description: Style for the outer Pressable.

props.name: height
props.description: Track height; the thumb scales with it. Defaults to 18.

props.name: width
props.description: Track width. Defaults to 32.

props.name: content
props.description: The tip's text; the body text of a rich tooltip.

props.name: action
props.description:
Rich only: a text button. A rich tooltip with an action stays open while
the pointer is over it (web) and until the action is taken or the anchor
is long-pressed again (native).

props.name: enterDelay
props.description:
Hover dwell (ms) before the tip appears on web. Without it, sweeping the
pointer across a toolbar flashes every tooltip in the row.

props.name: hideDelay
props.description: Auto-hide delay (ms) after long-press on native.

props.name: leaveDelay
props.description: Grace period (ms) before the tip leaves on hover-out.

props.name: title
props.description: Rich only: the subhead.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"plain"` is the one-line label for an icon-only control. `"rich"` adds a
`title` and an `action`, for context a label cannot carry. Defaults to
`"plain"`.

props.name: actions
props.description: After the title: up to three action `IconButton`s per M3.

props.name: divider
props.description: A hairline under the bar.

props.name: elevated
props.description: The on-scroll state: `surfaceContainer` instead of `surface`.

props.name: leading
props.description: Before the title: typically a back or menu `IconButton`.

props.name: safeArea
props.description: Pads the top safe-area inset. Defaults to `true`.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A second line under the title.

props.name: variant
props.description:
`"small"` and `"center"` keep the title in the 64dp row; `"medium"` and
`"large"` move it to a second, larger line. Defaults to `"small"`.

props.name: color
props.description:
A palette name (`"primary"`), a palette path (`"text.secondary"`), a
Material 3 role or any raw colour. Defaults to `"text.primary"`.

props.name: gutterBottom
props.description: Adds MUI's 0.35em bottom margin.

props.name: noWrap
props.description: One line, truncated with an ellipsis.

props.name: variant
props.description: MUI type-scale step. Defaults to `"body1"`.

props.name: theme
props.description:
Both schemes, from `createTheme()`. Defaults to the organization's theme.
Create it once, at module scope: a new object every render rebuilds
every component's styles.

props.name: badge
props.description: Trailing text, e.g. an unread count: `24`, `"100+"`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading glyph. The active state strips an "-outline" suffix.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this is the current destination.

props.name: showDivider
props.description: Draws a divider above the section — between it and the one before.

props.name: title
props.description: Section headline.
